Same-day admission surgery accounted for most of the cases and was associated with the poorest continuity of care. To provide complete surgical training in an era of changing therapeutic modalities and same-day admission surgery, vascular programs must be creative in structuring training to include adequate ambulatory experience.

question: "Occult" posttraumatic lesions of the knee: can magnetic resonance substitute for diagnostic arthroscopy?
